target: More efficient, production PostgreSQL drop-in replacement; MySQL/TDS compatibility also requested

gates.requirement: Complete the PostgreSQL feature inventory, upstream and application regressions, and stock tooling round trips.
gates.qualified: The latest stock PG16 and PG18 named-template checks passed all 45 cases, including archives and WAL reopen. The writable-template follow-up round-trips the three-database fixture locally on PG18. Shared roles, large objects and the wider application regression suite remain open.

gates.requirement: Synchronous commit-before-ack; crash recovery; exclusive writer; failed-storage guards
Complete role and privilege parity and authenticated MySQL/TDS support.
gates.qualified: PostgreSQL SCRAM, SCRAM-PLUS and catalog role credential configurations.

gates.requirement: Finish exact-artifact TLS qualification across hosted platforms, including documented worker, cluster and listener gaps.
gates.qualified: PostgreSQL TLS 1.3 preview with channel binding, encrypted cancellation and explicit native workers qualified with libpq on Linux.

gates.requirement: Qualify wide schemas, multiple 100M-row tables, mixed read/write concurrency and bounded execution.
gates.qualified: Runtime table and query budgets, native workers, and a durable 100M-row integral fact table with two dimensions.

gates.requirement: Full catalog images, online backup, automatic retirement, bounded write stalls and upgrade migration.
gates.qualified: Offline whole-WAL copy and opt-in live checkpoint generation publication, WAL handoff and process-crash recovery for supported single-database images.

gates.requirement: Qualify published artifacts across the original full suite and production-like workloads, including multi-table reads and durable concurrency.
gates.qualified: The wider source candidate passed both original million-row cases with same-host Linux reply caching and indexed IRDB at 2.22x and 2.88x. The earlier published image failed the capacity probes. Twelve of sixteen workloads met the significant-advantage gate in the prior broader reviewer run.

gates.requirement: Service lifecycle, deployment monitoring, general migrations and native SB0 hosted-feature parity.
gates.qualified: Six hosted packages, native SB0X and SB0K boot qualification, PostgreSQL cancellation and documented checkpoint recovery.

gates.requirement: Physical power interruption, directory synchronization faults and storage device fault qualification.
gates.qualified: Process termination around manifest publication and WAL handoff, and an injected selector rename failure.
